title: Sales Executive (Omoda & Jaecoo)
fit: New Omoda & Jaecoo dealership in Huntingdon. Car sales experience is only 'preferred' – they want customer service experience and a sales track record, which your BCA and Curve Media work cover. They ask for a full UK licence held 3+ years, so check yours qualifies.
desc: Sell new cars plus add-ons such as service plans and insurance at a new Omoda & Jaecoo showroom. Leads come from enquiries, walk-ins and follow-up calls. Keep your diary up to date, hit sales targets, explain the products confidently and run test drives. They want customer service experience (about 2 years), a sales track record and a full UK licence held for 3+ years; motor trade experience preferred, not essential. Full-time, on site.
cover:
Hi Grainger Motor Group recruitment team,

I'd like to apply for the Sales Executive role at your new Omoda & Jaecoo dealership in Huntingdon. My CV is attached.

I work at BCA in Bedford, handling dealership drop-offs and collections, MOT and service movements, vehicle preparation and customer handovers, so I'm in and around dealerships every day.

Before that I spent over a year in sales at Curve Media, finding my own leads through cold calling and email and closing premium packages with business owners and football and music representatives. I haven't sold cars yet, but I know how to follow up leads, handle objections and close.

A new brand and a new showroom is exactly where I'd like to learn the full car sales process.

Kind regards,
Rougier Williams
07407 433797
prep:
30-SECOND PITCH
I work at BCA with dealerships every day – drop-offs, MOT and service movements, handovers – and before that I sold premium advertising packages at Curve Media from cold calls and emails. I haven't sold cars yet, but I can generate and close leads, and I want to grow with a new brand.

LIKELY QUESTIONS
• Why car sales? You already love the cars and the dealership side at BCA; sales is where you want to build a career.
• Tell me about a sale you closed. Use a real Curve Media deal: how you found them, the objection, how you closed.
• How would you follow up a lead that's gone quiet? Call, then email, keep notes in the diary, offer a test drive.
• What do you know about Omoda & Jaecoo? Chery's newer brands – well-equipped SUVs, petrol, hybrid and electric, at value prices.
• How do you handle targets? Curve Media was target-driven; you kept your own pipeline.
• Weekends? Say yes if you can.

ASK THEM
• What training do new sales executives get on the brand and on finance?
• How are leads shared between the team at a new site?

RESEARCH
The Omoda 5 / E5 and Jaecoo 7 range and prices; Grainger Motor Group's other sites (Royston, Letchworth, Cambridge).
checkNote: Page live with apply form + listed on Grainger careers list
